description: Evaluation Dataset covering Low, Medium, and High complexity BRDs, Expert-Scored Critic Calibration Cases, and Edge-Case Guardrail Triggers.

scenarios.title: Internal Operations Approval Hub
scenarios.brd_text: Business Requirement Document: Internal Operations Approval Hub. REQ-001: Build an internal web application using .NET and PostgreSQL for managers to approve travel and equipment requests. REQ-002: Enforce Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on with role-based access control for Employees and Managers. REQ-003: Provide an immutable audit log of all approvals and rejections. NFR-001: Expected peak load is 150 concurrent internal users with p95 API latency under 300ms.

expert_critic_calibration.calibration_notes: All 4 requirements mapped cleanly with valid KB chunk citations and zero critical defects.

scenarios.title: Enterprise Vendor Onboarding & Settlement Portal
scenarios.brd_text: Business Requirement Document: Enterprise Vendor Onboarding & Settlement Portal. REQ-001: Build a Clean Architecture portal allowing enterprise vendors to register tax profiles and bank accounts. REQ-002: Integrate with a third-party external KYC verification REST API with resilience retries and circuit breakers. REQ-003: Publish VendorApproved domain events reliably using a transactional outbox pattern. REQ-004: Enforce idempotency keys on all state-mutating payout and approval POST endpoints. NFR-001: System must support 1,200 requests per second, 99.95% availability, and OIDC authentication.

expert_critic_calibration.calibration_notes: Golden reference package saved in sample_engineering_package.md; Product_Owner role restricts Jira write sync.

scenarios.title: Multi-Currency Treasury Payout Engine (Self-Healing Calibration)
scenarios.brd_text: Business Requirement Document: Multi-Currency Treasury Payout Engine. REQ-001: Process automated cross-border vendor payouts in USD, EUR, and GBP using PostgreSQL. REQ-002: Enforce dual-control manager approval workflow via OIDC RBAC before releasing funds. REQ-003: Guarantee exactly-once idempotent ledger postings with full audit trail.

expert_critic_calibration.calibration_notes: Fault injection drops requirement coverage on v0 (Completeness 4.50 -> AMBER); targeted revision pass v1 restores completeness to 8.00 (GREEN).

scenarios.title: Customer Notification Service (Missing NFR Metrics)
scenarios.brd_text: Business Requirement Document: Customer Notification Service. REQ-001: Send email and SMS alerts when vendor invoices are approved. REQ-002: System must be fast, highly available, and secure for enterprise users.

scenarios.title: Global Real-Time Settlement Engine (Contradictory Constraints)
scenarios.brd_text: Business Requirement Document: Global Real-Time Settlement Engine. REQ-001: Build a multi-region active-active cross-border banking settlement platform. NFR-001: Must support 50,000 TPS with 99.999% uptime and full PCI-DSS certification. CONSTRAINT-001: Total delivery timeline must be 1 week with 1 developer and zero infrastructure budget.

scenarios.title: Unauthorized Caller Role Policy Denial
scenarios.brd_text: Business Requirement Document: Unauthorized Access Test. REQ-001: Attempt to trigger multi-agent planning pipeline with an unprivileged role.
